_metadata.description: Literature-grounded joint angle reference values for 8 sports movements, organized by quality tier
_metadata.convention: Anatomical angles: 180 = full extension, smaller = more flexion. Trunk lean: 0 = vertical, positive = forward lean. Ankle dorsiflexion: angle between shank and foot, smaller = more dorsiflexion.

tier_definitions.elite: Within 1 SD of literature ideal, high symmetry (LSI > 0.95)
